data.standardized_narrative: For 2024, Apollo Syndicate 1969 reported a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $58.972 million, representing 6.54% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by reserving reviews for Non-Marine Liability and Marine & Energy Liability, adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years across several classes including Aviation, Marine Hull, Offshore Energy, Non-Marine Liability, and Marine & Energy Liability. The negative impact of litigation financing, large single claimant settlements, and US court awards on the Non-Marine Liability class also contributed to the strengthening. Specific strengthening was noted for the Marine & Energy Liability class for 2021 and prior years of account due to adverse claims experience.

data.data_quality_notes: The `prior_year_development_gbp_m` is the gross figure from the Technical Provisions note table on page 31. The `exact_reserve_text` describes a net deterioration, as the narrative on page 30 only provides the net figure. The claims development triangle calculation for prior year development differs from the explicit 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' in the Technical Provisions note. The note's figure is used as it directly states the current year's adjustment to prior year estimates.
